newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Arab states foreign ministers blast Israeli move to build new Jewish settlement in East Jerusalem.
- Agriculture minister says a 25-year agriculture development programme started.
- Floods claim seven lives in Asir province.
- Saudi port official says the kingdom plans new projects to develop and improve port services at a cost of 413 million riyals.
- Saudi Arabia praises outcome of the Islamic summit which was held in Pakistan.
- Saudi's al-Jouf Agricultural Development Company to set up a sugar plant at a cost of 335 million riyals.
